program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-finding passes; consolidate, admit, validate, and merge once after Wave 2000

source_provenance: Sider Scholar + NCBI PubMed exact-source verification
repository-wide PMID collision screening using the Waves 1501-2000 PMID index through Wave 1825

policy.validation_strategy: PMID-level dedupe/source verification during authoring; expensive repository-wide validation only after Wave 2000

waves.focus: Case-control/cross-sectional analysis found lower serum vitamin E in MS and associations with cognition/disability, but authors explicitly call for longitudinal studies and RCTs before supplementation benefit can be inferred.
Centennial review confirms vitamin E essentiality in deficiency while highlighting persistent uncertainty around broader disease-prevention/therapeutic effects of tocopherols and metabolites.

Large Japanese electronic-record analysis evaluated vitamin E exposure in relation to vancomycin-associated nephrotoxicity; retrospective pharmacoepidemiology should remain association evidence rather than a prophylaxis recommendation.
Two-sample Mendelian-randomization study examined genetically proxied vitamin-E status and depression; genetic causal-inference evidence remains distinct from clinical supplementation trials.

Genetic series identified TTPA-related ataxia with profound vitamin-E deficiency; three of four patients improved after high-dose replacement, supporting disease-specific deficiency treatment rather than general neuroenhancement.

Uncontrolled 60-day selenium-plus-vitamin-E study in ESRD found improved oxidative/inflammatory markers but nonsignificant erythrocyte outcomes; combination and absence of control prevent causal attribution.

Large Chinese cross-sectional study found sex-specific nonlinear associations between plasma vitamin E and homocysteine; U-shaped patterns in men argue against simplistic more-is-better interpretation.

Narrative review of four experimental studies suggests topical vitamin-E-containing formulations may modify acquired enamel pellicle and reduce erosion; evidence is local/topical and largely experimental.
Review describes liposomal/nanoemulsion approaches to improve topical vitamin-E stability and skin penetration; formulation technology evidence does not establish clinical superiority.
Cell-model nanomaterial study combining oxygen delivery, citric acid and vitamin E showed divergent redox effects in healthy versus cancer cells; entirely preclinical and formulation-specific.
Meta-analysis of 49 studies found neither oral nor IV N-acetylcysteine reduced contrast-associated AKI, dialysis or mortality; strong direct null against routine prophylactic benefit.

Randomized trial evaluated NAC for cognitive symptoms during exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation in patients with mild cognitive impairment; co-rehabilitation context requires endpoint-specific interpretation rather than NAC-only generalization.
Genetic/animal/cell study identified SPATA22-related ovarian dysfunction and found NAC partially rescued mouse/cell phenotypes; translational rescue is preclinical, not human fertility efficacy.

Double-blind pilot RCT in youth with NF1 found NAC was generally tolerated but did not improve primary motor, secondary cognitive/behavioral or exploratory biomarker outcomes; two participants stopped for worsening behavior.

Dermatology review describes plausible and early clinical uses of NAC but notes most studies remain small and methodologically limited; condition-specific evidence should not be flattened into broad skin-benefit claims.

Secondary analysis of a 302-person cannabis-use-disorder NAC trial identified heterogeneous craving trajectories associated with psychiatric symptoms and outcomes; craving-class analysis does not demonstrate NAC efficacy.

Double-blind RCT in 50 adolescents found cyclical oral NAC reduced menstrual pain, rescue ibuprofen use and urinary oxidative-stress marker versus placebo; small short study needs independent replication.
Protocol describes a planned double-blind trial of oral NAC for early-onset preeclampsia progression; no efficacy data are available yet.
Human ovarian-tissue xenograft study found oral NAC in mice produced little to no reduction in oxidative stress or follicle-survival improvement; preclinical direct null.
NAC-functionalized dendrimer study improved experimental drug-carrier characteristics and glioma-cell uptake; nanocarrier engineering evidence is unrelated to oral NAC clinical effects.

NAC-enabled inhaled mRNA lipid nanoparticles improved delivery and antitumor immunity in mouse models through surface remodeling/mucolysis; this is platform-preclinical evidence, not systemic NAC anticancer efficacy.
Human-leukocyte in-vitro study found NAC reduced metabolite/ammonia-induced DNA damage in most conditions; cellular protection does not establish clinical benefit in urea-cycle disorders.
Rat/cell hepatocellular-carcinoma study found NAC altered Nrf2/redox and transcriptomic pathways and reduced experimental tumor progression; entirely preclinical.
Targeted fucoidan/NAC nanoparticles improved delayed acetaminophen liver injury in mice by combining antioxidant delivery with neutrophil-recruitment blockade; nanoformulation animal evidence only.
In-vitro endodontic study found NAC medicament altered sealer penetration relative to calcium hydroxide; local dental material interaction is not evidence for systemic NAC effects.
